## In Class

**Tutorials for this week** (standalone documents, under the Tutorials section):

- [The Multivariate Gaussian — A Working Reference](../tutorials/12-multivariate-gaussian.qmd) — the density, the results table, linear transformations, marginals and conditionals.
- [Inequalities Worth Knowing](../tutorials/13-inequalities.qmd) — Markov, Chebyshev, Jensen, Cauchy–Schwarz, the union bound, and the weak law in three lines.
- [Comparing Distributions](../tutorials/15-comparing-distributions.qmd) — KS, transport cost, KL and its link to maximum likelihood, and the two families of divergence.

*Optional, under Tutorials · Advanced:*

- [Why the Gaussian?](../tutorials/14-why-gaussian.qmd) — four independent arguments that arrive at the same density.

**Interactive demo**

- [The Gaussian Lab](../materials/gaussian-lab.html) — the bivariate normal and what Σ controls; affine maps of a Gaussian cloud; and the central limit theorem with four non-Gaussian sources.
